```plato

    //==
    // # SDF modifier application
    //
    // The parameter records declared in `implicit-sdf.types.plato`, applied to
    // a source field. Value modifiers reshape an already-sampled distance; domain
    // modifiers reshape the position BEFORE the source is sampled, so they compose
    // with `MapDomain`.
    //
    // A domain modifier keeps the source's fidelity only while the map it applies
    // does not STRETCH: rounding, shells, onions and elongation preserve exact
    // distances, but repetition, twist, bend and displacement can all report MORE
    // than the true distance, which is not a bound at all
    // (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`) and tunnels a sphere tracer. Each says below
    // what makes it safe again.

    // The rounded distance: subtracting the radius inflates the shape and rounds
    // its edges. Exact when the source distance is. (IQ: opRound.)
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfRoundingModifier, distance: Number): Number
        => distance - self.Radius;
```

    // The shell distance: the region within half of Thickness on either side of
    // the source surface. Exact when the source distance is.
    // (IQ: opOnion, single layer.)
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfShellModifier, distance: Number): Number
        => distance.Abs - self.Thickness * 0.5;
```

    // The distance to the outermost of the concentric shells. Repeat this with the
    // distance it returns to peel the next layer; Count layers reach TotalDepth.
    // Exact when the source distance is.
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfOnionModifier, distance: Number): Number
        => distance.Abs - self.Thickness;
```

## Line 502

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato, line 502](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato#L502).

```plato

    // The displaced distance: the source distance offset by the sampled scalar
    // field value scaled by Amplitude. NOT a bound: the displacement adds to the
    // distance as readily as it subtracts, so the result can EXCEED the true
    // distance to the displaced surface and a sphere tracer stepping by it tunnels.
    // Dividing by one plus Amplitude times the displacement field's Lipschitz
    // constant recovers a lower bound. (IQ: opDisplace.)
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfDisplacementModifier3D, distance: Number, sourceValue: Number): Number
        => distance + self.Amplitude * sourceValue;
```
